\begin{example} \end{example}[Cayley complex of $\Z _2*\Z _2$] ↗ def:cayley-graph-and-complex ↗ def:free-product-of-groups ↗ ex:cayley-complex-cyclic-group 1. ch1:1.48\group Covering Spaces

For $G=\Z _2*\Z _2=\langle a,b\mid a^2,b^2\rangle $, the Cayley complex is an infinite chain of spheres and the quotient is $\RP ^2\vee \RP ^2$. The same construction for $\Z _m*\Z _n$ is tree-like. \end{example}
